in_sanskrit.name: Ivria
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Rains
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ivria एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ivria is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ivva', meaning rain. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Indra is often associated with the rains. Ivria is a tribute to the divine power of rain, symbolizing renewal, growth, and nourishment.
